body:
Maintainer request from #1572 (MCP `import_model` parity and documented agent surface).

Depends on #1873 and #1874 (inherits qualified formats from #1875).

## Goal
Update MCP `import_model`, `cam.import` script bindings, and the `camcraft-mcp` skill document for native CAD conversion, explicit `units`, and clear `cadmpeg` refusals.

## Scope
- Extend `s_import`, `TOOLS` description, and `import_model` in `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` (`lines 27, 145`) and `v_import` (`cam.import`) in `crates/app/src/script/api.rs` with an optional `units` parameter (`"mm"` or `"in"`).
- Include resolved `source_units` in the JSON return value alongside `model`, `facets`, `reduced_fidelity`, `facet_budget`, and `notes`.
- Accept qualified native CAD extensions via `ImportModel::within` (`crates/app/src/commands/import_model.rs`) and surface missing-`cadmpeg`, old-version, `cadmpeg check` failure, and missing-STEP-units errors cleanly through tool responses.
- Update `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` (around `line 66`) to document qualified native CAD formats, the external `cadmpeg` requirement, and the optional `units` argument. (Include `Process change: yes` in the PR body because the PR edits a skill file.)
- Add MCP and scripting tests covering native CAD stub conversion, unit override on unitless STEP exports, `source_units` reporting, and named error replies.

## Done means
`import_model` and `cam.import` accept qualified native files and `units`, return resolved `source_units` and named errors cleanly, `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` matches the schema, and MCP tests pass.

Part of #1572
